title: An n-plane is determined by the H^n-integrals of C_c functions over it
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and T, T' ∈ G(N,n). Here G(N,n) = Grassmannian N n consists of the symmetric idempotent real N×N matrices of trace n, and S.plane is the range of the orthogonal projection represented by S. Let H^n = μHE[n] be the n-dimensional Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N. If ∫_{T.plane} g dH^n = ∫_{T'.plane} g dH^n for every g ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), then T' = T.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T T' : Grassmannian N n), (∀ g : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ), ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫ y in (T'.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), g y ∂μHE[n]) → T' = T
